labels.label:
This flow retrieves objects from a Salesforce database 
table, filters the data using a SQL query, merges the data 
and writes the data in CSV, JSON or AVRO to a target S3 
or ADLS destination.

Flatten JSON: Flattens nested JSON properties into 
simple key/value pairs if Data Output Format is 'CSV' 
since CSV convertion can not handle nested values.

WriteToS3/ADLS: This processor writes the data to the 
specified target destination S3 bucket or ADLS container.

Route On Data Output Format: In case of 'CSV' Data 
Output Format the incoming JSON has to be flattened 
since CSV can not handle nested properties properly.

QuerySalesforceObject: This processor retrieves objects 
from a Salesforce database table, filtered by field name(s). 
The processor then converts the data to JSON format 
using a RecordWriter.

Set s3_adls.path attribute & Set S3/ADLS Path:
These processors set the S3 or ADLS path of the 
target destination.

Define a KPI on this connection to monitor 
failed write operations.

Split JSON: Splits JSON array into multiple JSON 
objects before flattening to avoid nested objects 
in the CSV.

create database Assurant;
CREATE TABLE Assurant.SFDCcases (
    CaseNumber STRING,
    ContactId STRING,
    AccountId STRING,
    AssetId STRING,
    SourceId STRING,
    Type STRING,
    Status STRING,
    Reason STRING,
    Origin STRING,
    Subject STRING,
    Description STRING,
    ClosedDate TIMESTAMP,
    IsEscalated BOOLEAN,
    OwnerId STRING,
    CreatedDate TIMESTAMP,
    CreatedById STRING,
    LastModifiedById STRING,
    ContactPhone STRING,
    ContactMobile STRING,
    ContactEmail STRING,
    ContactFax STRING,
    Comments STRING
)
STORED AS ICEBERG
TBLPROPERTIES (
    'iceberg.catalog'='hadoop.catalog',
    'iceberg.catalog_location'= 's3a://go01-demo/user/jprosser/Assurant-Bronze',
    'write.format.default'='parquet',
    'format-version'='2'
);

Filter Records: This processor filters records using a 
SQL query. The default SQL query forwards all records.

Merge Records: This processor converts the filtered 
records to a specified output data format.  It uses 
RecordReaders and RecordWriters to accomplish this. 
Destination data formats supported by this flow are 
CSV, JSON and AVRO. To avoid writing lots of small files, 
this processor is configured to write out a file every time 
its size has either reached 100MB or five minutes have 
passed. Files can reach a maximum size of 1GB.

parameters.description:
Specify the name of the destination S3 bucket or ADLS container you want to write to.

For S3, enter a value in the form:
s3a://[Destination S3 Bucket]

For ADLS, enter a value in the form:
abfs://[Destination ADLS File System]@[Destination ADLS Storage Account].dfs.core.windows.net
parameters.name: Destination S3 or ADLS Storage Location

parameters.name: CDP Workload User
